name: Masala oats
how: Cook the oats with onion, tomato, peas and spices in a little oil and water until soft.

name: Besan chilla with yogurt
how: Whisk gram flour with water, onion, tomato and coriander; cook thin pancakes in a little oil.

name: Vegetable poha
how: Rinse the poha, then toss with onion, peas, turmeric and peanuts in a little oil; finish with lemon.

name: Moong dal chilla
how: Blend soaked moong dal into a batter, stir in spinach and onion, and cook thin pancakes.

name: Egg bhurji on toast
how: Scramble the eggs with onion and tomato in a little oil; serve on whole-wheat toast.

name: Oat porridge with banana
how: Simmer the oats in milk, top with sliced banana and crushed peanuts.

name: Tofu scramble with toast
how: Crumble the tofu into a pan with onion and spinach, season, and serve on toast.

name: Yogurt bowl with apple and oats
how: Top yogurt with chopped apple, a spoon of oats and a few cashews.

name: Dal with brown rice and salad
how: Cook the dal with tomato, onion and spices, finish with a little ghee; serve with brown rice and cucumber salad.

name: Chana salad bowl
how: Toss boiled chickpeas with cucumber, tomato and onion; dress with lemon and olive oil.

name: Rajma with roti
how: Simmer cooked rajma in an onion-tomato masala; serve with two thin rotis.

name: Grilled chicken with quinoa and broccoli
how: Grill the seasoned chicken; serve with cooked quinoa and steamed broccoli.

name: Fish curry with brown rice
how: Simmer the fish in a tomato-onion gravy with a splash of coconut milk; serve with brown rice.

name: Paneer and pepper stir-fry with roti
how: Stir-fry paneer cubes with peppers and onion; serve with two thin rotis.

name: Tofu and vegetable stir-fry with rice
how: Stir-fry tofu with broccoli and peppers, a little soy sauce and sesame oil; serve with brown rice.

name: Lentil and vegetable soup with bread
how: Simmer red lentils with carrot, onion and tomato until thick; serve with a slice of whole-wheat bread.

name: Egg curry with bajra roti
how: Simmer boiled eggs in an onion-tomato curry; serve with bajra (pearl millet) roti.

name: Chicken, vegetable and barley soup
how: Simmer chicken with barley, carrot, celery and onion until the barley is tender.

name: Black bean and rice bowl
how: Warm cooked black beans with peppers and onion; serve over brown rice with tomato and lime.

name: Salmon with sweet potato and spinach
how: Bake the salmon and sweet potato; wilt the spinach in a pan with a little oil.

name: Mixed vegetable sabzi with roti and raita
how: Cook cauliflower, peas and carrot with spices; serve with two rotis and a bowl of raita.

name: Roasted chana
how: A small handful of roasted chickpeas.

name: Apple with peanuts
how: Slice an apple and eat it with a small handful of peanuts.

name: Cucumber raita
how: Stir grated cucumber into yogurt with a pinch of cumin.

name: Banana
how: One medium banana.

name: Boiled egg and cucumber
how: One boiled egg with cucumber sticks.
